stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_001
stage_help.msbt.text:
Right, let's learn the basics! Your goal
is to eliminate all of the viruses in the
bottle. To clear a virus, place capsules
that match its color next to it to create
a set of four matching pieces in a
horizontal or vertical line. If you plan
ahead, you can form chain reactions
that eliminate many viruses in one go!

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_002
stage_help.msbt.text:
Dr. Luigi's speciality is using L-shaped
capsules called "L-capsules" to clear
viruses. In every other respect this
mode plays like Dr. Mario, but it's very
important to remember that Dr. Luigi's
capsules require a bit of a different
strategy because of their shape.

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_003
stage_help.msbt.text:
As the difficulty increases in Dr. Luigi
mode, his L-capsules change from
having three pieces in one color and
one in another to having two pieces in
one color and two in another. This can
really change how you place them. Try
out this style of L-capsule here, in a
slightly harder stage.

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_004
stage_help.msbt.text:
Capsule Blasters are handy when you
need to clear out excess capsules.
Use one in a set of its own color, and
all matching capsules will vanish.

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_005
stage_help.msbt.text:
Capsule Blaster Z is a truly remarkable
miracle cure. Use it in a set of any
color, and all of the capsules that are
in your bottle will disappear!

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_006
stage_help.msbt.text:
Virus Blasters are an incredible way to
clear your bottle fast. Use one in a set
of its own color to eliminate every
virus of that color in one go!

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_007
stage_help.msbt.text:
Zappers are very useful when things
are looking grim. They blast entire
lines clean, eliminating both viruses
and capsules with surgical precision.

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_008
stage_help.msbt.text:
When dire times call for drastic action,
nothing works quite like an Exploder.
The moment it lands, it detonates,
taking out everything around it.

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_009
stage_help.msbt.text:
Can you use a Zapper or Exploder to
activate both the Virus Blaster and the
Capsule Blaster in one go? If so, you
can trigger quite an impressive combo!

stage_help.msbt.label: STAGE_HELP_DESCRIPTION_010
stage_help.msbt.text:
Some miracle cures disrupt opponents
during vs. play. Reversers swap the
controls, Lockers prevent rotations,
and Boosters increase drop speed.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_001
menu.msbt.text:
Play a variety of specially designed stages in
which you can experiment with the different
miracle cures and learn how best to use them.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_002
menu.msbt.text:
Play Dr. Mario, Dr. Luigi, and Virus Buster
after configuring various settings to customize
your experience. Different game types are
available for Dr. Mario and Dr. Luigi games.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_003
menu.msbt.text:
Connect to Nintendo Network, and engage in
online battles with fellow players from around
the world. You can also check the rankings
and your ratings for online battles here.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_004
menu.msbt.text:
Connect with nearby players for vs. and co-op
play.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_012
menu.msbt.text:
This mode uses basic capsules and
button controls.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_013
menu.msbt.text:
This mode uses L-capsules and button
controls.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_014
menu.msbt.text:
This mode uses basic capsules and
Touch Screen controls. Tap a capsule
to rotate it, and drag and drop a
capsule to move it.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_015
menu.msbt.text:
This game's not over till game over!
Viruses continue to appear steadily in
your bottle from below. See how long
you can last before your bottle fills up.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_016
menu.msbt.text:
Eliminate every virus to clear a stage
and move to the next one--each is
harder than the last.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_017
menu.msbt.text:
Take on the CPU in a frantic battle.
Win by eliminating all of your viruses
first or by using chains and combos
to make the CPU lose.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_OPTION_UPPER_DESCRIPTION_001
menu.msbt.text:
While this option is on,
you can make capsules
fall instantly by pressing
up on the +Control Pad.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_OPTION_UPPER_DESCRIPTION_002
menu.msbt.text:
While this option is on,
ghost images will appear
to mark where capsules
will land.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_OPTION_UPPER_DESCRIPTION_003
menu.msbt.text:
This option lets you orient
the screens based on which
hand you use to hold the
stylus. This allows for more
comfortable play when you
hold your system vertically.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_NETWORKPLAY_RANKING_SELECT_TOP_DESCRIPTION_UP
menu.msbt.text:
View the players who fill the top
100 positions in the rankings for
each kind of online battle.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_NETWORKPLAY_RANKING_SELECT_PERIPHERY_DESCRIPTION_UP
menu.msbt.text:
View your position in the rankings and
the positions of those around you for
each kind of online battle.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_NETWORKPLAY_RANKING_SELECT_RECORD_DESCRIPTION_UP
menu.msbt.text:
View your rating for each
kind of online battle.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_LOCALPLAY_TOP_MENU_01
menu.msbt.text:
Play together with someone nearby who
also owns this game.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_LOCALPLAY_TOP_MENU_02
menu.msbt.text:
Play together with someone nearby who
doesn't own this game. Please tell your
partner to select Download Play on his
or her system's HOME Menu.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_LOCALPLAY_JOIN_MENU_01
menu.msbt.text:
Start looking for a partner. Please note, if
you select Invite, you should tell the person
you want to play with to select Join.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_LOCALPLAY_JOIN_MENU_02
menu.msbt.text:
Join a partner who has issued an invitation
from his or her system.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_NODATA_RANKING
menu.msbt.text:

you have yet to participate in this kind of
online battle.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_NODATA_NET_RECORD
menu.msbt.text:
Unable to display your rating because
you have yet to participate in this kind
of online battle.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DLP_CLIENT_WAIT
menu.msbt.text:
Looking for a Download Play partner...
Please wait.

Press the B Button to stop the search.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_NETWORKPLAYER_UPPER
menu.msbt.text:
Connect to Nintendo Network, and battle
players from around the world. Your results
will affect your ratings.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_NET_001
menu.msbt.text:
Win by destroying all of your viruses
first or by using chains, combos, and
sabotaging miracle cures to make your
opponent lose.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_NET_002
menu.msbt.text:
Win by destroying all of your viruses
first or by using chains and combos
to make your opponent lose.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_NET_003
menu.msbt.text:
Destroy all of your viruses first to earn
a point. The first to earn three points
wins. Virus levels and capsule drop
speeds will be set at random.

menu.msbt.label: MENU_DESCRIPTION_NET_004
menu.msbt.text:
Team up with a partner to do battle
against the viruses. Work together to
eliminate them as quickly as you can.
